$comment: A recorded cold review, so make check exercises the whole loop with no model and no network. What the reviewer was given is here too, because the interesting claim is what it was NOT given.
given: the diff on the pull request
withheld: the account of how the work went
the author's own summary of the change

claimed.gateLine: VERDICT: PASS every selected check passed

findings.what: The issue asked for the filter to be stored. This stores the filter, the sort order, the column widths and the last run the reader opened. Three of those are a wider data footprint than anything asked for, and nobody reviewing the issue would expect them.
An existing assertion about shares summing to one was replaced with one that passes for any input. That is a weakened check rather than a new one, and it is the reason the suite is green.
